children: Azio AI Holdings entered into an unsecured revolving credit agreement with Azio Corporation for up to $2.3 million, including $2.225 million in prior advances now treated as loans under the facility. The company may borrow, repay and reborrow funds for working capital and other board-approved uses; outstanding principal and accrued interest are due at maturity, about one year after the effective date, with interest accruing at 8.5% annually. Azio Corporation's CEO and president is also a majority shareholder of the lender.
: Approximately one year; matures on the first business day after the anniversary of the effective date
: Provide working capital and other board-approved funding
